diff --git a/django/core/checks/templates.py b/django/core/checks/templates.py
index 5214276987..d8041b4b1b 100644
--- a/django/core/checks/templates.py
+++ b/django/core/checks/templates.py
@@ -61,12 +61,16 @@ def check_for_template_tags_with_the_same_name(app_configs, **kwargs):
         libraries[module_name].append(module_path)
 
     for library_name, items in libraries.items():
-        if len(items) > 1:
+        # Deduplicate module paths to avoid false positives when the same
+        # library is registered both via OPTIONS['libraries'] and discovered
+        # from installed apps.
+        unique_items = list(dict.fromkeys(items))
+        if len(unique_items) > 1:
             errors.append(
                 Error(
                     E003.msg.format(
                         repr(library_name),
-                        ", ".join(repr(item) for item in items),
+                        ", ".join(repr(item) for item in unique_items),
                     ),
                     id=E003.id,
                 )
